timing.note: Wall time includes local inspection, binding/domain/model work, testing, reporting and final artifact audit. Individual command times are separately recorded; no labor-time precision claimed.

limits: No global protocol search or safety-invariant evaluation. No distributed reachability proof; all local injected states need a separate reachability argument before system-bug claims.

Two directions share vocabulary and projections; correlated mapping mistakes remain possible. TLC selects finite symbolic descriptors and executes original model actions, not a separate Python oracle.
Node uses actual channels and deterministic barriers, but there is no scheduler enumeration, cancellation, removed-node proposal gating, or arbitrary concurrent caller coverage.
Four-server action domain excludes the quorum sort allocation threshold; supplied package tests are supplemental, not bidirectional comparisons.
No arbitrary bytes/unknown protobuf fields, snapshot data, remote/lease read semantics, disk failures, post-restart application replay, broad pagination, transport or crash histories.
Empty Node Ready delivery, response inputs from unknown peers and local messages through public RawNode.Step are outside the supported action domain.
Observer histories and invariant predicates are untouched; recommended observer correction and potentially intended implementation-defect properties need the later invariant phase.
